cards.name: Neon flicker-on
cards.summary: A neon-sign title that stutters on with a few quick blinks, then holds lit inside a coloured glow halo.
use_for: a word that 'switches on' in a hook
avoid: sober news and documentary
photosensitive audiences: keep the flicker under 3 blinks per second and about a second long
thin or small type (the halo swallows it)
Random Strobe Probablity above 0: it makes random bursts (measured: 10 reached 6 flashes in one second), so the blinks run on Period instead (0.4 s: 2.5 a second, under the 3-per-second limit)
the After Effects preset Opacity Flicker In measured 5 flashes in its worst second (pve check flags it): fine on a small title, but on one a quarter of the screen or bigger use the Premiere version

Hindi/Devanagari (measured 2026-10-13): per-character animators split dependent vowel signs (matras) from their consonants mid-animation, though the settled text shapes correctly and the timing stays within 0.08 s of the Latin; for Hindi animate per word or per line (a by-word / by-line preset or template, e.g. 'Mask rise reveal')

Premiere: order matters (glow first, Strobe Light last) so the whole lit sign blinks. Strobe 1 = Makes Layer Transparent; each blink lasts Period - Duration = 0.06 s, at clip time 0, 0.4 and 0.8 s (Random Strobe Probablity 0: an even 2.5 blinks a second), and Blend With Original reaching 100 at 1 s stops the flicker.
